verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's own marketing claims customizable automation for ongoing monitoring and says it 'automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team.' The docs also describe one background behavior: an automatic pending review that reopens a case after about 90 days. However, workflows appear to be configured by the vendor ('We can easily configure your Hummingbird account'), and no self-serve automation builder is documented. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation builder (triggers, actions, schedules), details on how agents run autonomously in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: It automates routine work, moves cases between agents and your team, and keeps every decision defensible.
Streamline your onboarding, ongoing monitoring, or ad-hoc investigations using customizable automation
Hummingbird creates a "pending" review of the case that will automatically open when it's time to review the case again (typically 90 days).
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
